title: Auditing Gender Analyzers on Text Data

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the prediction accuracy and misclassification patterns of commercial and open-source text-based gender analyzers (UCLASSIFY, READABLE, HACKERFACTOR) and ChatGPT by inputting social media comments from Reddit and Tumblr and comparing the outputs against self-identified ground truth labels for male, female, and non-binary authors.
